The New York Times on Instagram: "Autumn Durald Arkapaw won the Oscar for best cinematography for her work on “Sinners,” making history as the first woman, and first woman of color, to win that category.

In her acceptance speech, after citing predecessors, like the cinematographer turned director Rachel Morrison, Durald Arkapaw said, “I’m so honored to be here and I really want all the women in the room to stand up because I feel like I don’t get here without you guys.”

She had already set a record as the first woman of color to be nominated for the prize, and in an interview last month, Durald Arkapaw told us, “I’ve always wanted to make big movies.”

Read more about her win, and find our full interview with Durald Arkapaw at the link in our bio. Photo by @vnina"
